lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Donald Trump said Friday that Stephen Miller was replacing Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff, mere days after Republicans lost control of the U.S, The Canadian Press reports.

The 82-year-old estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, was arrested Friday morning in Florida on a charge of possessing child sexual abuse material in storage units in California, authorities said.
Tesla’s Cybertruck, the hulking, stainless-steel pickup that inspired devotion and derision with its science-fiction looks, will cease production next year, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
